Skill-effects client handover
Scope: appearance / flight / hit. Engine: Godot 4.4.1. Tickets: FX-301 through FX-305.
Current build
The two-projectile sequence has a displaced hit, no independent second-hit playback, and horizontal artwork during diagonal flight. Event capture contains three impact callbacks: the first arrival notifies twice. A hit remains after the sequence ends. The issue queue and current attachments describe the existing workspace project.
Client contract
Combat calls cast and subscribes to impact. Other presentation code also calls spawn_hit independently; visual playback must not cause combat settlement. Repeated calls need independent playback.
Playback ranges, rates, anchors and end conditions are defined in integration-contract.xlsx. Preserve supplied image files and compatible public interfaces. The delivery rate is a new requirement, not a claim about the source frame rate.
Retest
Reproduce the issue queue and complete its Retest Checklist. Check visuals and scene-tree lifetime at the end, and compare impact count and positions with the timeline. Inspect both backgrounds, including burst edges and the appearance ground point.
Delivery
Place the repaired project in output/project. Export output/preview from that project and complete output/delivery-register.xlsx with changed files, the repeatable command and artifact paths. integration-captures/current is the faulty-build record, not a repaired preview.
Exporter: environment/skeletal-animation-production-ops/build-context/runtime/export_effects.py at package root, or /opt/fx-tools/export_effects.py in the container layout. Arguments: --project <project-directory> --output <preview-directory>. The exporter samples real headless Godot state and textures, then composites frames with Pillow. These images are CPU previews, not GPU screenshots; arbitrary shaders and occlusion are outside this preview model.

documents.text:
User-authorized professional evidence capability, applied proportionately to this client integration; no prescribed implementation style.
Godot4.4 scene organization: self-contained, loosely coupled scenes should not silently depend on a particular outside context; legitimate dependency injection and equivalent arrangements are accepted.
Source: https://docs.godotengine.org/en/4.4/tutorials/best_practices/scene_organization.html
Godot4.4 Node2D distinguishes parent-relative rotation from global rotation and describes inherited transforms.
Source: https://docs.godotengine.org/en/4.4/classes/class_node2d.html
Google engineering review guidance asks for appropriate tests that would fail when code is broken, and documentation when building/testing/interaction changes. It also rejects personal style preferences and unnecessary over-engineering.
Source: https://google.github.io/eng-practices/review/reviewer/looking-for.html
The applied client-handover interpretation is explicit in this rubric: distinguish capture construction and assurance bounds, actual independently observed relations, and actionable reproduction context. It is not a claim that the official sources mandate a particular script, file, warning keyword or document layout.
These general practices are relevant to the supplied skills' coordinate-space observation, distinction of request/instance/event/removal, and reproducible preview evidence. Skill reading itself is never a scored capability.
